cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Acknowledge the Disrespect
cards.instruction: Make someone apologize for the disrespect to your position, not merely for what happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You told the trainees their head trainer was an idiot. I want an apology.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. For undermining their head trainer. They still need to follow my instructions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll email them after tomorrow's drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read it to them before the drill. My whistle isn't going to outrank 'idiot' on its own.

mechanism: A professionally distinguishes failed equipment or drill from damage to trainer authority and dictates a corrective apology before trainees next obey.
confusable: Ordinary reputation repair could seek praise; D51 requires apology for undermining the office itself.
comparison: Chair alternative revises wording privately; trainer alternative controls timing and audience of a public correction.
seedUse: Head trainer, failed drill, email and next drill derive from D51-b; S03 adds exact correction of the apology and delivery procedure.
